category.name: IT asset management
category.description: Hardware/software asset inventory, ownership and lifecycle records; discovery and service-management capabilities differ.
category.audience: IT, procurement and operations teams managing organization devices and software inventory.
category.audienceRationale: Assets affect most staff, but the direct operators and buyers are IT and procurement specialists rather than all employees.

pricing.note: Starter includes 2,000 assets and unlimited seats; billed annually. Page extraction combines multiple currency amounts without reliable currency labels, so entry amount remains unverified.

Quote for current ITAM plan and weighted asset units (packs of 500), with additional IT-plan requirements. One desktop equals 1 AU, server/VM/network device 4 AU; not a flat per-device or agent-seat price.

oss.name: Snipe-IT
oss.classificationReason: AGPLv3 self-operated asset management; official FAQ explicitly confirms hosted and free installations use the same software. Hosting, maintenance and priority support are services. Third-party integrations may have separate terms.

health.rsx: Authenticated shared analysis completed; overall 5.7/10. Automated health signals, not security certification.

serviceLimitations: Managed hosting tiers differ in infrastructure, API rate limits, LDAP resources and support; self-hosters operate their own server.
Discovery integrations can require separate MDM/RMM systems; Snipe-IT does not supply its own network discovery agent.

oss.name: GLPI
locked: Subscriber-exclusive Cloud Inventory retrieves assets from cloud services.
Subscriber-exclusive collaborative notifications and advanced dashboard plugins; OAuth SSO/SCIM and other extensions also vary by subscription.
oss.classificationReason: GPLv3 core with free asset inventory/CMDB; GLPI Network sells access to exclusive plugins covering everyday cloud inventory, integrations and reporting as well as administration. Community-plugin support subscriptions do not make those public plugins paid-only. Plugin licenses were not individually audited.

health.rsx: Authenticated shared analysis completed; overall 5.5/10. Automated health signals, not security certification.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Rebuild asset assignments, ownership and license records using CSV/API and validate identifiers/history. Snipe-IT is a lifecycle record system; independent network discovery, vulnerability enrichment, ITSM workflows and application mapping need separate integrations.

Configure inventory collectors, map assets/relationships and validate imports. GLPI covers inventory/CMDB with broader ITSM options, but cloud discovery and selected integration/reporting plugins require subscriptions. Do not assume Lansweeper OT/vulnerability enrichment or Freshservice service mapping parity.
